reviews.text: Everyone here was so kind and really loves and knows cats. Including the two feline greeters on staff who really wanted to meet every patient. We had a more thorough visit for a second opinion than any other appointment we had for our sweet Bombay. Dr. Helen Tuzio gave us everything we could ask for during such a difficult time. She even called to follow up in detail and offered comforting words while supporting our decision making process. We definitely recommend this practice if you call yourself a cat person - glad there is someplace we can turn!

I brought my four year old cat, Eloise, in for an upper respiratory infection and conjunctivitis in her right eye. As always, I was greeted warmly by the friendly staff. Everyone was so excited to meet Eloise and Dr Tuzio was so kind and gentle with her and did a thorough exam. They showed me how to administer her eye ointment and they were very sweet with her when she cried having her temperature taken. It’s always a pleasure bringing my babies to the Forest Hills Cat Hospital.

Amazing!
Would absolutely recommend with no hesitation!!

Forest Hills Cat Hospital is a wonderful place! My cat is well cared for, all of the staff members are kind & helpful, & the Veterinarians are great at explaining what’s going on with my cat. It’s a great place!

I can’t THANK EVERYONE at Forest Hills cat hospital ENOUGH for taking the BEST care of both my cat Bacardi and my sisters cat Nachos as patients and then again when we had to DEVASTATING  rehome them due to circumstances BEYOND our control. They were the ONLY facility that ACTUALLY were of ANY help during a VERY stressful time!!!

I needed an appointment quickly as my cat was vomiting in a way that seemed urgent (but not an emergency). Staff at Forest Hills Cat Hospital were able to squeeze me in the same day I called, and I saw Dr. Nanton (along with the very helpful vet assistants). Dr. Nanton was amazing and thoroughly explained everything that he observed, possible causes, and possible next steps. They gave me a clear itemized cost estimate before conducting any testing. I agreed to all of Dr. Nanton's recommendations, and they were able to get my cat some blood tests, imaging, and eventually an enema. Dr. Nanton was very clear in his explanations of what he saw on the imaging and what he thinks could be happening (and also clear about areas that he was still unsure about, which I appreciate).

My cat is feeling much better now and thanks to the thorough testing, we have a better idea of how to treat health problems moving forward (he was diagnosed with an issue that was not previously caught by any earlier testing done at other hospitals). I was so pleased with my experience that I brought my other cat in for a check-up about an allergy issue that has been on-going for years, and that I have been unable to get clear answers about.  Dr. Nanton again very clearly explained what he knew and what testing was possible, and finally after many years of simply not knowing, we are getting allergy testing for my cat and he is on a medication that he seems to be responding well to.

The entire team, from office staff, to vet assistants, to Dr. Nanton, is extremely friendly and helpful. I love that this hospital is cats-only. The environment is calm, and cute! I have already recommended this place to my fellow cat-owning friends and will continue to do so.
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Caroline. Thank you so much for the review!

So allow me to begin by telling you that I have been a member of the Forest hills cat hospital for about the last 30 years. In fact I was a member when it actually was in Forest Hills. Dr Luger, who started this practice... ran the most incredible cat hospital, until he retired a few years ago. He still pops in every once in a blue moon... But there are other doctors who have taken over his practice. And the doctors there are wonderful.... But over the years, the service, the waiting time, and especially the price...has gotten worse . After a few horrible visits the past few times... and then doing some research and finding out that this is the most expensive cat veterinary care in the area.. I had no choice but to write to the hospital and tell them I could no longer be a client. You'd think after 30 years that perhaps I would get a phone call, or even just some form letter apologizing....but no.... nothing. And honestly, knowing Tiffany their office manager... I'm not surprised. She does however send one wicked passive aggressive note to customers she does not like. Anyway after 30 years Forest hills cat hospital.... time to do better. But for me... it is goodbye... And I'm actually not happy about it, but you've left me no other choice.

Follow up 7/16/26

Took Tiffany a bad review on Google to address my issue (months afterwards)..except that once again, she sent a passive aggressive note blaming US for the discourse in the office, and she didnt even send it to me, who wrote this review, she sent it to my wife, to forward to me.. It's really sad what has happened to this practice..they used to be the BEST !!!! Now they lack respect, and they charge WAY too much. Ok...I'm done with them, and this negative rant.

Also, they are not pushy when it comes to more expensive items/tests. They are transparent about the prices upfront and didn’t pressure me at all towards a certain direction.

Overall I’d recommend this Vet for anyone’s pet cat!

So, so happy with my experience here. I’ve brought my cat in a few times over the course of the last two weeks for eye issues. She needed surgery, within two days of bringing her home i noticed her eyes seemed to be infected (she was able to get her cone off at some point) so i brought her in again. I’ve seen a few doctors in the last two weeks and all have been very thorough with her care. They’ve all made her comfortable - the best she’s performed at the vet, and given me great instructions for her care. I truly trust all of the doctors & techs here. I brought my cat in today for the infection and she’s already home and doing so much better. Shes drinking more water, is scratching at her cone less, and is clearly experiencing much more comfort. Highly recommend!!

Super thankful to have brought my cat here! The staff is so kind, knowledgeable, and truly caring. A more affordable option as well. The time and care that is taken with your loved one means a lot, especially when they are experiencing illness. An awesome hospital!
Had a great experience here! Truly cat experts who are very knowledgable about what they do. Made the experience as comfortable as possible.

Waited for 2 whole hours and 30 minutes. The vet Dr. Sheheri was extremly rude and judgemental. She jumped to conclusions and would not let me get a word in to properly explain our care for our cat. She said our cat has arthritis before examining him (cuz that's how you diagnose arthritis. By locking eyes with a cat and examining his aura), and after examining him and realizing that he is healthy, she quietly let that go, even though she made a snappy comment regarding how poor our care was that a young cat like him has arthritis. Again, he does not hava arthritis. Or else, you know she'll be slapping us with a billion tests and snooty comments.

The price was also grossly more expensive than other places we've been to that didn't let us wait for 2 whole hours and 30 minutes. The actual examination was 10 min.

I am deeply disappointed in this practice, specifically with the care—or lack thereof—provided by Dr. Savalla. While the front desk staff and vet techs were kind and professional, my experience with the veterinarian was heartbreaking and unprofessional.
I booked an appointment online for a much-needed ultrasound for my cat, who has heart disease and cannot handle long car rides. After several scheduling shifts (initially told 3–6 p.m., then 4–5 p.m.), I was forced to arrive early to "see the doctor first." When I arrived, Dr. Savalla completely ignored me, speaking only to the vet tech until I finally spoke up.
The lack of empathy only worsened from there. My cat was breathing heavily, and while I understood the gravity of his condition, Dr. Savalla’s approach was cold and alarmist. She warned me that he might foam at the mouth or that I might get into a car accident on the way to the Animal Care Center. She then began aggressively pushing for immediate euthanasia.
When I explained that I wanted him to pass peacefully at home with his family, she continued to pressure me to do it right then and there. She even insisted on calling an at-home service herself before I left. Most concerningly, when my cat’s own cardiologist spoke to us on speakerphone and recommended an emergency chest tap to stabilize him, Dr. Savalla dismissed the specialist’s advice, calling it "painful" and reiterating that I should just euthanize him.
To top it off:
She complained to her tech in front of me about having to stay past her 3 p.m. shift.
She removed my cat from oxygen and left the room without checking his stability or breathing.
I later received a text bill for over $400 for a visit where she provided minimal care (oxygen and Lasix) without a proper evaluation.
There is a compassionate way to guide a grieving owner through a terminal diagnosis, and this was not it. Dr. Savalla lacks the empathy required for this profession. If you are looking for supportive, specialist-aligned care for a sick pet, I would look elsewhere.

Bona fide cat people at this vet! I chose Forest Hills Cat Hospital because I wanted a place that specialized in cat care, and this was it. Dr. Sheheri and her assistant were very patient and gentle with my cat, knowing how to handle her with patience and understanding. I brought my cat in for an emergency and left relieved with a better understanding of my cat's prognosis. Very fast lab results, thorough treatment instructions, and fairly transparent about cost.

Danielle(*), Dr. Nanton, and Dr. Luger were life preservers for me when my cat suffered from congestive heart failure. While there was nothing more the hospital could do for her, Dr. Luger and the staff were so open and informative about every step they took to help her, and explained fully how their actions might help her. When she ultimately succumbed to her illness, Dr. Luger answered all our questions and made me feel so comfortable. And Danielle, the receptionist, was a beacon of light through it all, as was the entire veterinary staff and crew. They were just truly so sweet and warm the whole time. I didn't get all their names, but they were all incredible.

(*) apologies if I spelled your name wrong!

My cat died an HOUR after leaving Forest Hills Cat Hospital. I brought my cat in for our appointment at 2:30 and we weren’t seen until 4pm. I told the vet he was having wheezing and coughing fits and they told me they couldn’t run any tests on him because it was “the end of the day.” We were sent home and my cat was fine for about half an hour before he had another wheezing fit that just continued to escalate and eventually he stopped breathing while we were on the way to a different vet.

If the vet took my cat’s health seriously and did his job correctly, maybe he would still be alive right now. If you care about your cat’s life DO NOT take them to this cat hospital.
